title: Morning Intel
bullets: Markets: Nasdaq confirmed a correction after last week's AI-driven rout (Nvidia -8.7%, ~$2.2T wiped off Nasdaq-100); Friday saw a partial rebound (S&P +0.3%, Nasdaq +1.1%), and futures ticked up Sunday night (S&P +0.1%, Nasdaq 100 +0.3%) heading into the new trading week.
Markets: Oil rebounded, with Brent crude +3.9% to ~$98/bbl after a near-9% one-day drop.

Companies: AI-spending skepticism lingers after Alphabet and Meta earnings failed to reassure investors on AI returns; Anthropic's reported $1.5T IPO valuation is facing investor pushback post-selloff.
Companies: Heavy earnings week ahead - Constellation Energy, KKR, Barrick Mining, Occidental and Take-Two report Monday; Cisco and Applied Materials follow later in the week.
Macro/Policy: Democrats' historic midterm gains add to the political uncertainty weighing on AI/tech sentiment.
Macro/Policy: October CPI lands Tuesday Nov 10 (consensus +0.3% headline, +0.2% core m/m) with PPI Friday - the key data ahead of the Fed's Dec. 9 meeting, where cut odds sit near 77%.
